hooks.text: 用200余种武器、动力和功能方块拼装车辆，四家公司决定初始积木与能力
hooks.excerpt: With 200+ blocks across weapons, propulsion and utility, there’s no shortage of wild ideas that just might work. Wheels, boosters, buzzsaws, orbital lasers - snap them together however you like. Each of the four TerraTech Corporations brings its own set of blocks and abilities to the table, so your starting point shapes what you build and how you fight.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 武器、前部重量和推进器布局决定炮台、冲撞或高速脆皮路线，重心还会影响转向
hooks.excerpt: Stack on the weapons and you're a rolling gun platform. Go heavy at the front and you're built to ram. Pile on the boosters and you're fast, fragile, and hard to catch. Where you put things matters - weight, balance, and whether you can actually steer it all come into play.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 四名驾驶员分别走冲撞、眩晕重掷、穿敌暴击和漂移等专属玩法
hooks.excerpt: Jean Pierre hits hard and keeps on hitting - built for impact and impossible to slow down. Mikela plays the odds by stunning enemies and rerolling her luck until the rarest blocks fall her way. Sam phases through enemies and doubles down with critical hits. Cepheid drifts through the battlefield leaving a trail of plasma in her wake. Each character comes with their own starter build and playstyle - find the one that fits how you fight.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
